scenario: Light and dark Reader fixtures keep normal accent, warning, and muted text above the AA text threshold across the core paper surfaces; authentication and command-palette inputs expose visible keyboard focus indicators.

repair: Darkened the light-theme accent to #99441a, warning to #8c5a0b, and muted token to #6e604f so text remains readable on the core paper, inset, panel, and secondary-panel surfaces.
Replaced the translucent authentication input focus outline with an opaque accent outline and a two-pixel offset.
Added an explicit accent focus outline to the command-palette input, which previously disabled the native outline without a replacement.
Added failure-first browser baselines for both themes, the four core surfaces, and the two previously untested input focus states.

Added settled-list and settled-reader animation guards to the axe gate so opacity transitions are not misreported as contrast failures; the ArticleList index was separately moved from border-strong to muted after a settled probe identified its 1.5:1 contrast.

known_limit: The core-page axe gate now includes color-contrast and passes after animation settlement; this fixture evidence still does not prove native iPhone text selection, screen-reader output, real production proxy behavior, or staging/production auth and theme persistence. Dark-theme full-page axe is represented by the dedicated token and ArticleList subgates rather than the default-theme core-page axe path.
